comment: Python stack, the "gate" section of .kit.json (point it here with "gate": "tools/gate.json"; keys: docs/kit-json.md). The globs and the test command are defaults to edit: point the globs at the project's source and test folders, and the tests are found under tests/ with no tests/__init__.py needed (the repository root is on the path), but the modules import as top-level names, so relative imports between test modules do not work (use absolute ones: `from tests import helper`); the pass line requires at least one test to have run; swap the command for ["{python}", "-m", "pytest", "-q"] if the project uses pytest (then pass on its summary line instead of the unittest Ran N tests and OK). tools/js_tests.py is installed but not wired: for Node-only tests (node:test) add a step {"name": "js-tests", "globs": ["tests/js/*"], "cmd": ["{python}", "{root}\\tools\\js_tests.py", "--glob", "*.test.cjs", "tests/js"], "warn": true}; without node on PATH it prints a SKIPPED, NOT RUN line and the warn flag shows it in the verdict.
